title: Exact Certification of the 11-Dimensional Kissing-Number Upper Bound
description: Exact rational certification of the degree-17 Bachoc-Vallentin three-point semidefinite-program bound tau_11 <= 868. The package fixes the objective at 86899/100, verifies all 1,497 affine identities and 70 matrix blocks, and includes an independent standard-library Python replay. The result improves the previously rigorous integer upper bound from 869 to 868; it does not determine tau_11 or claim a new numerical optimum.
notes: The release includes the inspected technical paper PDF, deterministic source archive, standalone exact certificate-and-verifier archive, and SHA-256 inventory. DOI fields remain unassigned until the exact public GitHub release assets have been archived and independently verified.
